title: Temperature Control with Sinusoidal Flow Disturbances Using Internal Model Control
expert_review: An advanced control problem demonstrating the internal model principle for sinusoidal disturbance rejection in thermal systems.
learning_objectives: Model thermal systems with time-varying flow disturbances
Apply the internal model principle for sinusoidal tracking
Use Nyquist plots to verify stability of complex systems
